name: Platinum Vape | 200mg Live Resin Gummies | Watermelon Rush
description: This isn’t your average melon. It’s a full-blown watermelon wave — sweet, tangy, and crashing into your taste buds with a rush of real fruit flavor and that unmistakable live resin kick. It's summer in a gummy, no matter the season.
